currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Game currencies and resources, organized by island. Open a resource to find related articles and documented buffs.
currencies.explorerDescription: Explore runes, bonuses, upgrades, masteries, milestones, perks, cores and stages. Open sources or edit their relationships in the existing wiki editor.

entries.name: Energy
entries.description: Energy is the main tycoon currency, produced every second by your machines. It pays for new machines, machine and Factory upgrades, tycoon buttons and every stage gate.

entries.name: Gears
entries.description: Gears are the automation currency, produced by Gears Generators. They pay for every Automation upgrade and the Special Gears Frames tycoon button.

entries.name: Crystals
entries.description: The Crystals area is the crystal wing of the tycoon, opened with the Crystalization Extractor button for 500 thousand Energy.

entries.name: Jewels
entries.description: Jewels are the first special crystal currency, earned passively after unlocking them through crystal progression.

entries.name: Crystal Shards
entries.description: Crystal Shards are a higher crystal currency earned through crystal progression, with Crystal, Platinum and Adamantium upgrades increasing their gain.

entries.name: Quartz
entries.description: Quartz is the Merge Grid currency, produced every second by each element and multiplied by higher merge tiers. It is spent on Merge Upgrades, and 250 million Quartz is required for the Bluesteel reset.

entries.name: Bluesteel
entries.description: Bluesteel is the Merge Grid reset layer, unlocked with a Merge Upgrade.

entries.name: Magnets
entries.description: Magnets are collectibles unlocked through Merge Upgrades in the Bluesteel area, costing Bluesteel. They have a 15-second base spawn rate and a maximum of ten spawned at once.

entries.name: Life Shards
entries.description: Life Shards are earned whenever you create life. They pay for a long board of upgrades boosting Energy, Crystals, Fossils, Logs, Research and more. Holding 250 thousand Life Shards unlocks the Fossil reset.

entries.name: Life Gems
entries.description: Life Gems are Life Island’s main currency, earned passively and multiplied by Terraform income bonuses, Monster, Fossils and other upgrades.

entries.name: Fossil
entries.description: The Fossil reset consumes 250 thousand Life Shards and converts them into Fossils; the True Fossil Gain is shown before confirmation.

entries.name: Logs
entries.description: Logs are the principal tree currency, dropped by every tree you cut. They pay for Logs Upgrades that boost axe damage, Logs gain, critical hits, Tree XP, Apple Chance, Sap, Research and more.

entries.name: Sap
entries.description: Sap is the second tree currency, dropped alongside Logs. Sap Upgrades boost Logs, Sap, Apples, axe damage, Tree Level Perks, Auto Cut, Fossils, Research, Roots, Life Gems and tree XP and perks.

entries.name: Roots
entries.description: Roots are the third tree currency, dropped at higher tree tiers and gated by Tree Tier requirements.

entries.name: Apples
entries.description: Apples drop randomly while cutting trees; Apple Chance and More Apples upgrades increase their drops.

entries.name: Research
entries.description: Research Points are the currency of the Research board, unlocked with a tycoon button on Life Island.

entries.name: Golden Points
entries.description: Invest Golden Points into six targets. Each bonus starts at its required investment.

entries.name: Red Liquid
entries.description: Red Liquid is the Monster area’s feed currency, earned through the monster and boosted by the first Monster Upgrade.

entries.name: Dark Liquid
entries.description: Dark Liquid is the currency earned by sacrificing monsters. It pays for the separate Dark Monster Upgrades board, which further boosts the monster area, and is tracked in your Life Island inventory.

entries.name: Frost
entries.description: The Frost area is Life Island’s frozen wing. Three machines produce IceShard every few seconds; Frost Upgrades improve income, machine speed, Tree Roots, Dark Liquid and Golden Research.

entries.name: Tree Essence
entries.description: Tree Essence is he fourth Tree related stat, you obtain it with roots, and can get milestones up to 1M, whose boosts: Fossils, Logs, Researches and unlocks new upgrades!

entries.name: Money
entries.description: The Upgrade Tree is the main Money sink: 83 nodes bought with Money that boost Money, Energy, Perk Points, Crystals, Inflation, Crystal and Jewel multipliers, Opal, Stone, Prestige and Energies unlocks.

entries.name: Gold Bars
entries.description: Gold Bars are the first Money Island reset layer, converting Money into Gold Bars.

entries.name: Emeralds
entries.description: The Emerald Reset consumes Money and Gold Bars and grants Emerald Coins. Emerald Upgrades boost Starter Money, Gold Bars, Emerald Coins, Money and Energy inflation, Energy Shards, Mining Ores and more.

entries.name: Golden Diamond
entries.description: The Golden Diamond Reset is the third reset layer, consuming previous layers and granting Golden Diamonds. It first unlocks through Tree Ascension Rank 1.

entries.name: Gold Energy
entries.description: Enter your Silver, Golden, Diamond and Ruby Energy amounts to calculate bonuses and caps.

entries.name: Silver Energy
entries.description: Enter your Silver, Golden, Diamond and Ruby Energy amounts to calculate bonuses and caps.

entries.name: Ruby Energy
entries.description: Enter your Silver, Golden, Diamond and Ruby Energy amounts to calculate bonuses and caps.

entries.name: Diamond Energy
entries.description: Enter your Silver, Golden, Diamond and Ruby Energy amounts to calculate bonuses and caps.

entries.name: Ores
entries.description: Ores are the 32 mineable materials of Mining, from Stone, Coal and Tin to Painite, Meteorite, Amethyst and five diamond ores: Green, Red, Void, Black and Transcend Diamond.

entries.name: Stone
entries.description: Ores are the 32 mineable materials of Mining, from Stone, Coal and Tin to Painite, Meteorite, Amethyst and five diamond ores: Green, Red, Void, Black and Transcend Diamond.

entries.name: Cores
entries.description: Core is the Limit Breaker for Layers, you break the core layers for benefits and to unlock more layers.

entries.name: Dungeon Coins
entries.description: Dungeon Items are equipment drops in three categories: Swords, Shields and Accessories. Every item has a rarity and can be equipped in loadout slots.

entries.name: Bones
entries.description: Dungeon Items are equipment drops in three categories: Swords, Shields and Accessories. Every item has a rarity and can be equipped in loadout slots.

entries.name: Bone Dust
entries.description: Dungeon Items are equipment drops in three categories: Swords, Shields and Accessories. Every item has a rarity and can be equipped in loadout slots.

entries.name: Souls
entries.description: The Souls Reset consumes Dungeon Coins, Bones and Bone Dust and grants Souls, but drain 15% of your health and strength, with a 5 minutes cooldown.

entries.name: Rune Stone
entries.description: The Energetic rune is paid with Energy at 1 million per roll.

entries.name: Rune Luck
entries.description: The Energetic rune is paid with Energy at 1 million per roll.

entries.name: Eternal Shards
entries.description: Eternal Shards are the premium slow currency. They accumulate automatically in real time and can also be bought with Robux.
